en: Twas the night before new years. Twas the night before new years when all through the house
zh: 那是新年前夕。新年前夕，整個房子裡
ja: それは大晦日の夜でした。家中が静まり返っていた大晦日の夜、
local: Twas the night before new years. Twas the night before new years when all through the house
native: Twas the night before new years. Twas the night before new years when all through the house

en: not a creature was sleeping not even a mouse. Red envelopes were packed by grandpa and
zh: 沒有一個生物在睡覺，連老鼠也沒有。爺爺和
ja: 誰も眠っていませんでした。ネズミさえもいません。おじいさんと
local: not a creature was sleeping not even a mouse. Red envelopes were packed by grandpa and
native: not a creature was sleeping not even a mouse. Red envelopes were packed by grandpa and

en: grandma in hopes that good wishes would be for us all. The children ran wild energy from
zh: 奶奶準備著紅包，希望大家都能收到祝福。孩子們因晚餐後充滿活力地奔跑著，
ja: おばあさんが紅包を用意して、みんなに良い願いが届くことを願っていました。子供たちは夕食後のエネルギーで走り回っていました。
local: grandma in hopes that good wishes would be for us all. The children ran wild energy from
native: grandma in hopes that good wishes would be for us all. The children ran wild energy from

en: dinner while the parents spoke of times of old winter.
zh: 而父母則談論著過去冬天的時光。
ja: 親たちは昔の冬の時代について話していました。
local: dinner while the parents spoke of times of old winter.
native: dinner while the parents spoke of times of old winter.

en: At the stroke of midnight the noise simmered as all would gather around the candles that
zh: 午夜鐘聲響起時，喧囂漸息，大家聚集在閃爍的蠟燭旁，
ja: 真夜中の鐘が鳴ると、騒音は静まり、みんなが揺れるろうそくの周りに集まりました。
local: At the stroke of midnight the noise simmered as all would gather around the candles that
native: At the stroke of midnight the noise simmered as all would gather around the candles that

en: glimmered. Old and young lit and raised in sense ticks ablaze. Each recited words
zh: 閃爍著光芒。老少點燃蠟燭，感受著火光。每個人都朗誦著祝福的話語，
ja: 輝いていました。老若男女がろうそくに火を灯し、感覚を燃え上がらせました。皆が祝福の言葉を唱えました。
local: glimmered. Old and young lit and raised in sense ticks ablaze. Each recited words
native: glimmered. Old and young lit and raised in sense ticks ablaze. Each recited words

en: of best wishes and phrase. When out on the streets there arose such a bang I sprang to
zh: 最美好的祝福和詞句。當街上突然響起巨響時，我跳向窗邊，
ja: 最高の願いと言葉を。外の通りで大きな音が鳴り響き、私は窓に駆け寄りました。
local: of best wishes and phrase. When out on the streets there arose such a bang I sprang to
native: of best wishes and phrase. When out on the streets there arose such a bang I sprang to

en: the window to see what's the thing. Firecrackers were so loud sounds piercing our ear.
zh: 看發生了什麼事。鞭炮聲震耳欲聾，刺入我們的耳朵。
ja: 何が起こったのかを見るために窓へ向かいました。爆竹の音がとても大きく、耳をつんざくようでした。
local: the window to see what's the thing. Firecrackers were so loud sounds piercing our ear.
native: the window to see what's the thing. Firecrackers were so loud sounds piercing our ear.

en: Neighbors all around were wishing happy new year.
zh: 四周的鄰居們都在互道新年快樂。
ja: 周りの近所の人たちが新年の挨拶をしていました。
local: Neighbors all around were wishing happy new year.
native: Neighbors all around were wishing happy new year.

en: Mando and Dai Yi in Hakka come follow. Shinyan kwai lo. Shinyan kwai lo.
zh: 客家話的滿都和大義跟著說。新年快樂。新年快樂。
ja: 客家語の満都と大義が続きます。「シンニェン クァイ ロー」「シンニェン クァイ ロー」
local: Mando and Dai Yi in Hakka come follow. Shinyan kwai lo. Shinyan kwai lo.
native: Mando and Dai Yi in Hakka come follow. Shinyan kwai lo. Shinyan kwai lo.

en: Shinyan kwai lo. And that's the night before new year lunar. Hope 12 months move fast so we can celebrate soon.
zh: 新年快樂。那就是農曆新年前夕。希望12個月快點過去，讓我們能盡快慶祝。
ja: シンニェン クァイ ロー。これが旧正月の前夜です。12か月が早く過ぎて、すぐにお祝いできることを願っています。
local: Shinyan kwai lo. And that's the night before new year lunar. Hope 12 months move fast so we can celebrate soon.
native: Shinyan kwai lo. And that's the night before new year lunar. Hope 12 months move fast so we can celebrate soon.
